title: Critical Rendering Path
definition: The Critical Rendering Path (CRP) is the sequence of steps the browser goes through to convert HTML, CSS, and JS into actual pixels on the screen. Optimizing CRP is the foundation of frontend performance.
simpleExplanation: CRP is the exact recipe the browser follows: Read HTML -> Build DOM -> Read CSS -> Build CSSOM -> Combine into Render Tree -> Calculate Layout -> Paint Pixels.
diagramContent:
graph LR
  HTML[HTML] --> DOM[DOM Tree]
  CSS[CSS] --> CSSOM[CSSOM Tree]
  DOM --> RT[Render Tree]
  CSSOM --> RT
  RT --> Layout[Layout / Reflow]
  Layout --> Paint[Paint]
  Paint --> Comp[Composite]
